scope: Agent Utils native TTS and standalone STT transports; not the full multimodal Realtime model's audio protocol

requirements.contract: Azure remains the compatibility default. Explicit azure/openai/daemon selection routes once, with no shell, local fallback or replay after indeterminate admission.

Daemon tokens resolve lazily per request from TTS/STT_DAEMON_TOKEN (DAMEON alias accepted), then a configurable symlink-compatible token file. Credentials never enter request bodies, diagnostics, session persistence or downstream audio child environments.

Daemon jobs correlate request IDs and receipts; remote playback owns central queue/output, local playback explicitly downloads bounded PCM from the exact receipt path. Only terminal receipts settle success; no global mute is issued on session cancellation.
OpenAI audio/speech uses plain JSON PCM with provider-specific defaults and instruction controls; embeddings/unsupported controls fail explicitly. Body reads and cancellation remain bounded.

Read, assistant TTS, narration, choices, cascade and speak-replies share provider selection. STT/PTT, choice freeform and cascade input share batch provider selection; explicit realtime STT can use the daemon stream protocol.
Daemon STT streaming has bounded append queues, cursor deduplication, terminal/error handling and session abort/close cleanup; never replays audio after failure.

known_protocol_limits: The TTS daemon currently exposes no per-job cancellation. Aborting a client wait cannot retract admitted server playback. playback=local retains interruptible local audio but does not use daemon playback lanes.
